verdict.rationale: BigCommerce is an ecommerce platform, so in-product AI insights from store data is a fair axis to judge. The pack has no evidence of it. The only AI mentions are AI-powered search and chat and AI-ready page actions on the developer documentation site, plus an llms.txt file. These are adjacent docs-site features that do not analyze the merchant's own store data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
